regressions: CSV detection skips empty logical records while retaining original spans, including blanks after headers, between rows, whitespace/delimiter-only records and multiline quoted fields.
CSV with a blank between two recipients reaches Upload and saved campaign data with both recipients; recipient data is absent from AI instructions/history.
Oversized mixed paste is kept in a separate edit panel without replacing the old composer, changing history or creating files; send/save are locked until Apply or Discard.
Discard preserves existing text/history/file refs; editing to exactly 4000 characters and applying allows valid Agent draft save/reopen retaining chat and both files.
Oversized plain-text paste uses the same non-truncating review panel.
Electron dark wide and light narrow screenshots inspected; review actions remain reachable without horizontal overflow.
limitations: Renderer uses fixture IPC/stores/provider, not production provider or DB.
No Windows installer or manual live-app verification in this fix.
OCR implementation unchanged; prior real-worker/ASAR receipt remains separate evidence.
Pending paste review is transient; explicitly closing the entire unsaved form discards it.
database: No migration/RPC/ACL/connection changes or DB apply
release: Source and local production build only; no installer/release
